tagline: Leading provider of comprehensive cybersecurity solutions protecting networks, data and endpoints against advanced threats
hero_kpi_rationale: Recurring revenue is the primary driver of valuation in cybersecurity software, with strong predictability and high margins.

kpis.name: Recurring service revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from security subscriptions and software maintenance for updates, support, and cloud services.
kpis.description: The business model relies on maintenance and subscription contracts, which are very stable and predictable. In 2025, security subscriptions ($1,219M) and maintenance ($958M) together represent $2,177M.
kpis.signal: More than 80% of total revenue comes from recurring sources (subscriptions + maintenance).

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue remaining after deduction of direct production and service delivery costs.
kpis.description: The cost structure is light on production and delivery, enabling exceptional gross margins. Cost of revenues of $361.8M on revenues of $2,725.4M.
kpis.signal: Very high gross margin at 86.7%, typical of mature software publishers with strong SaaS component.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue, reflecting operating profitability before financial items.
kpis.description: Operating income of $831.1M on revenues of $2,725.4M. The decline is due to increased investments in R&D (+15.7%) and sales and marketing (+9.8%).
kpis.signal: Solid operating margin at 30.5%, down from 34.1% in 2024 due to an increase in...

kpis.name: R&D investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue invested in research and development of new security solutions.
kpis.description: R&D expenses of $456.7M in 2025 versus $394.9M in 2024. The 15.7% increase supports innovation particularly in Hybrid Mesh, Workspace, and Exposure Management domains.
kpis.signal: R&D investment rate increasing at 16.7% of revenue, reflecting efforts to integrate AI and develop...

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees worldwide working for Check Point.
kpis.description: Headcount increased to approximately 5,400 employees in 2025, concentrated in R&D, customer support, and professional services.
kpis.signal: Headcount in slight increase despite sector pressures, reflecting investment in talent...

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated total revenue of the company for the fiscal year.
kpis.description: Total revenue of $2,725.4M in 2025 versus $2,565.0M in 2024. Composition: products and licenses $548.2M (20%), security subscriptions $1,219.0M (45%), maintenance $958.2M (35%).
kpis.signal: 6% growth driven by 10% increase in security subscriptions and continued demand for...

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Total revenue of $2.725 billion last fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net income

risks.title: Intense competition from cybersecurity giants and AI
risks.score_rationale: Risk listed at the top in Item 3, with very strong language ('intensely competitive', 'materially adversely affect'). Upward trend with emergence of generative AI (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto, Microsoft) as new competition source. Dominant category in the filing.

risks.title: Risk of technology obsolescence and product innovation lag
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned as structural risk in Item 3, with strong language ('rapid technological advances', 'render our existing products obsolete'). Stable trend but amplified by AI revolution. High weight in an industry with short innovation cycles.

risks.title: Dependence on a limited number of product families
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly named risk in risk summary ('dependent on a limited number of product families'). Direct language without mitigation. Stable trend. Represents structural vulnerability in case of technology disruption or loss of competitiveness on a key product line.

risks.title: Product vulnerabilities exposing customers to cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: Central risk for a security publisher, explicitly mentioned ('If our products fail to protect against attacks'). Strong language with direct impact on reputation and business. Stable trend but high criticality given CHKP's positioning as guarantor of customer security.

risks.title: Dependence on a small number of key distributors and suppliers
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the 'Risks Related to Our Dependence on Third-Parties' section with clear language ('dependent on a small number of distributors', 'limited sources'). Stable trend. Moderate risk but could worsen in case of global supply chain disruption.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks related to operations in Israel
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section 'Risks Related to Our Operations in Israel' with explicit references to active conflicts (Israel-Hamas, Hezbollah, Iran, Yemen). Urgent and factual language. Upward trend given regional escalation. Headquarters and primary R&D located in Israel.

risks.title: Risks related to AI integration and associated legal liability
risks.score_rationale: New risk explicitly listed twice in summary ('Issues in the development and deployment of AI', 'Issues relating to our use of AI and machine learning'). Cautious language but regulatory environment described as uncertain. New and rising trend.

risks.title: Insufficient intellectual property protection and IP litigation
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section 'Risks Related to Our Intellectual Property' with three distinct sub-risks (IP protection, open source, third-party claims). Moderate language but recurring. Stable trend. Risk amplified by use of open source technologies and third-party components.

ai_positioning.summary: Check Point is progressively integrating artificial intelligence into its cybersecurity solutions to improve threat detection and response automation. In 2025-2026, focus is on securing enterprise AI transformation, with acquisition of Cyata for AI agent discovery and governance.
evidence: AI integration in Quantum Security platform for behavioral analysis
Launch of Check Point ThreatCloud AI for real-time threat correlation
AI used in data loss prevention (DLP) functions and Exposure Management
Acquisition of Cyata in Q1 2026 for End-to-End AI platform enabling AI agent discovery and governance
2026 strategy centered on securing enterprise AI transformation
